s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations
Multiple superficial ulcers with heaped-up margins
key_facts: CD4 count rose from 94 to 160 cells/mm3
Lip lesions developed 2 months after CD4 count improvement
Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus
Normal complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels
Negative Gram stain, acid-fast stain, and mucicarmine stain of lesion samples

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations
Multiple superficial ulcers with heaped-up margins
key_facts: CD4 count rose from 94 to 160 cells/mm3
Lip lesions developed 2 months after CD4 count improvement
Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus
Normal complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels
Negative Gram stain, acid-fast stain, and mucicarmine stain of lesion samples

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with painful lip ulcerations

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Fungal infection in an immunocompromised patient, although diagnostic tests were negative

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with unexplained weight loss and ulcerations

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic disease with possible mucocutaneous manifestations in an immunocompromised patient

raw.rationale: The patient's HIV-1 infection, improvement in CD4 count, and development of lip lesions with ulcerations are consistent with Kaposi's sarcoma, particularly given the lack of evidence supporting other diagnoses such as herpetic ulcers, bacterial infection, or fungal infection.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Negative fungal blood cultures and negative urine and serum Histoplasma antigen tests

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: No hepatosplenomegaly and lack of other systemic symptoms suggestive of lymphoma

rejected.label: Erythema multiforme
rejected.why: The patient's lesions have heaped-up margins and are not typical of erythema multiforme

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and diagnostic studies do not support a diagnosis of sarcoidosis
